references.text: The Israelites ate from the produce of the land after entering Canaan, and the manna ceased—a fulfillment of the promise of abundant stored grain.
Solomon's prayer mentions God's promises of blessing over the people, including abundance of food and crops.
Proverbs describes Wisdom's house as filled with riches and stored wealth, paralleling the promise of stored grain.
Jesus speaks of a homeowner who brings out both new and old from his storehouse—an image of spiritual abundance.
